$comment: Manifest-only bundle for the site-kit dashboard. deposit handles unknown routes in-app (app.routes '**' → ik-status-page + Cloudflare not_found_handling = single-page-application), so this emits ONLY /kit/manifest.json — no error pages, no worker. Made by the prebuild: site-kit-static --config site-kit.static.json --out public → public/kit/manifest.json, served at /kit/manifest.json.
